function parseNumber<T extends number>(text: `id-${T}`): T {
  return Number(text.slice(3)) as T;
}
function parseBigint<T extends bigint>(text: `id-${T}`): T {
  return BigInt(text.slice(3)) as T;
}
const one: 1 = parseNumber('id-1');
const decimal = parseNumber('id-01');
const big: -12n = parseBigint('id--12');
const hex = parseBigint('id-0xf');
function use<T extends { name?: string; size?: number }>(text: string, size: number) {
  let value: T['name'] = text;
  const length: T['size'] = size;
  console.log(value.toUpperCase(), length.toFixed(1));
  value = undefined;
  console.log(value);
}
use('hello', 4);
console.log(one, decimal, String(big), String(hex));
const options = { implements: 1, package: 2, public: 3, static: 4 };
console.log(options.implements, options.package, options.public, options.static);
function format(value: string | symbol) {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? 'value: ' + value + ` ${value}` : String(value);
}
console.log(format('text'), format(Symbol('tag')));
class Entry {}
function allowed(value: Entry | number, object: { key: number | undefined; optional?: number }) {
  delete object.key;
  delete object.optional;
  return value instanceof Entry;
}
console.log(allowed(0, { key: 1, optional: 2 }));
